question: Who received the Vigyan Shri award in 2024 for his contributions to Agricultural Science?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Anandharamakrishnan C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Anandharamakrishnan C** was honored with the **Vigyan Shri** award in **2024** for his outstanding contributions to the field of **Agricultural Science**.
 
• He currently serves as the **Director** of the **CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)**, located in **Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala**.
 
• His research work primarily focuses on **food processing**, **food engineering**, and the application of **nanotechnology** in the agricultural and food sectors.
 
• He is widely recognized for his pioneering work in **3D food printing**, **spray drying**, and **electrospraying** of food bioactive compounds to improve their bioavailability.
 
• The **Vigyan Shri** is one of the four categories of the **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar**, newly instituted by the **Government of India** to recognize distinguished contributions to **Science and Technology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar (2024):**
 
 
• The **Government of India** announced the first-ever **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar** in **2024**, replacing various previous science awards with a unified national framework.
 
• A total of **33 awards** were announced in **August 2024**, comprising **1 Vigyan Ratna**, **13 Vigyan Shri**, **18 Vigyan Yuva-Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar**, and **1 Vigyan Team** award.
 
• The awards were presented by the **President of India**, **Droupadi Murmu**, at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
 
 
• **Award Categories:**
 
 
• **Vigyan Ratna:** Awarded for lifetime achievements and contributions in any field of science and technology. In **2024**, it was awarded to **Prof. Govindarajan Padmanabhan** for his work in **Biological Sciences**.
 
• **Vigyan Shri:** Conferred for distinguished contributions to a specific field. Recipients in **2024** included **Prof. Jayant Bhalchandra Udgaonkar** (Biological Sciences) and **Dr. Avesh Kumar Tyagi** (Atomic Energy).
 
• **Vigyan Yuva–Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar:** Recognizes young scientists (up to **45 years** of age) for exceptional contributions.
 
• **Vigyan Team:** Given to a team of **3 or more** scientists for collaborative research work. In **2024**, this was awarded to the **ISRO Chandrayaan-3 Team**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Agricultural Science in RVP:**
 
 
• The inclusion of **Agricultural Science** as a dedicated category highlights the government's focus on **food security**, **sustainable farming**, and **agri-tech innovations**.
 
• **Dr. Anandharamakrishnan's** recognition emphasizes the importance of **value addition** in agricultural produce and the reduction of **post-harvest losses** through engineering interventions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar** is organized across **13 domains**, including **Physics**, **Chemistry**, **Biological Sciences**, **Mathematics & Computer Science**, **Earth Sciences**, **Medicine**, **Engineering Sciences**, **Agricultural Science**, **Environmental Science**, **Technology & Innovation**, **Atomic Energy**, **Space Science & Technology**, and others.
 
• The selection process is governed by the **Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar Committee (RVPC)**, headed by the **Principal Scientific Adviser** to the Government of India.
 
• Recipients of the **Vigyan Shri** award receive a **Sanad** (certificate) and a **Medallion**, but no monetary cash prize is associated with these specific national honors, focusing instead on the prestige of the recognition.
